instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. In a minimalist white studio, three friends sit closely on the floor. On the left, the woman with wavy light brown hair (R3) in a white shirt over a black top rests her head on the center woman's shoulder with her eyes closed. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a white high-neck top smiles gently at the camera. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a white shirt smiles warmly. They are locked in a cozy group hug. Soft, bright studio lighting fills the clean space.
elements: R3 rests her head on R2's shoulder
R2 provides the shoulder that R3 leans on
R3 has her eyes closed while leaning on R2
R1, R2, and R3 sit closely together in a cozy contact pose
